description: Returns the direct import graph for a specific file: what it imports, and what imports it. Use to answer: what depends on this file? What does this file depend on?

file_path.description: Path to the file (absolute or relative to project_root)

format.description: Output format — json (default) or mermaid flowchart diagram

project_root.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript project root (must contain tsconfig.json)

name: get_dependency_graph
